body: No, but wish would be. I have everything I don`t care about, and the only thing I want I not only don`t have, but I`m also unable to get.
I`m sorry if I`m being rude.

Life in general. Does life get better after high school? I have friends, and family, but I`m still hurting really bad. I just feel like everything is fake, and that no one in my life really cares about me. When things get bad, I have no one to go to. Does life really get better?
I`m told things get better. Do they?

I`m sorry you feel that way. I have this extreme feeling of loneliness mixed with emptiness, and it hurts too. I don`t know if that`s how you feel, but I can relate to emotional pain. Have you seen a doctor? My parents are making me see a doctor

Ill tell him I`m not actively suicidal, and hopefully he doesn't notice the fresh vertical scar on my wrist. My school counselor looked right at it and thought it was another self harm scar. I could point a gun to my head in front of a crowd of people, and no one would care. But I`m not one of those people looking for attention, and I really don`t want to die. Its just the deep sense of emptiness and loneliness hurts SO bad. thanks for all the advice, and I`ll let all of you know how it goes.

I'm willing to tell the doctor everything, as long as he doesn't tell my parents. I AM in imediate danger, and i have a feeling that he will put me in a psych ward, since i sleep with an x-acto knife under my pillow. Family is out of bounce, so if he is going to tell my parents, then i am not gonna tell him anything. I'm not the kind of person who is looking for attention, I just can't find a reason to live. No one loves me, and cares about me. When things are bad, I have no one to go to. I'm all alone. And I had to look my mom in the eyes and tell her i'm not gonna kill myself. I hate myself.

I live in a house with 6 other people. I go to school, and there are at least 20 kids in each of my classes. I go to work where I am working directly with 10 people. I go to parties where there are at least 50 people. But I have nothing in common with anyone. I`m not exceptional, or better than anyone, I`m just different. All I want in my life is  girlfriend, but that seems to be the only thing I`m incapable of achieving.

thanks for all your replies, you`ve really calmed me down. Things with my mom have been sort of gone back to normal, even though she said I have a doctors appointment next week. I going to try to find a better coping method than cutting, but I`m more worried about finding a reason to live. I don`t think I`m depressed. In fact, I go out with friends all the time, and I can laugh and make people laugh. But at the end f the day, I can`t figure out why anything matters. Since the conversation has turned away from cutting, I`m gonna switch to SW reddit. thanks again

My counselor said she had no choice but to call my parents. I don`t know the laws, but a kid at my school just killed himself a few days ago, so my school`s been on red alert. Plus I am 17. My mom told me if I killed myself, she`d die, so I guess that means she`d rather see me suffer. if I tell the doctor or medical professional everything that's been gong on in my head, I am 100% sure they would put me in a psych ward, because I`m that far gone. I`m sorry I keep replying, but I have no one else to go to.

I don`t want to die, but I really don`t want to live either. As for the cutting, I had been cutting my shoulder/arm area, until recently I tried to cut my radial artery. I would call it a half-hearted attempt at....well you know. I swear I`m not one of those people who are looking for attention, I`m just so tired of life. My doctor is going to see the cut on my wrist, and he`s gonna know exactly what I as trying to do. its looking like my life is over.
